Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3. The petitioner seeks quashing of the FIR no. 623/2021 registered at Police Station Uttam Nagar for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4. Issue notice.
Learned APP for State, who appears on advance notice, accepts notice and seeks some time to file status report.
Let the same be filed three days prior to the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.

Monu & Anr., 2022 9 SCC 321, the complainant/victim is entitled to be heard in the present proceedings.
